name: Egg Drop Soup
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical egg drop soup recipes using ~3 cups broth (standard 4 servings of ~1.5-2 cups each); instructions imply 1 egg total which is common for 4 portions.
Minutes estimated from sequential boiling, thickening, and egg-drizzling steps in instructions (no prep times given).
Eggs classified present due to explicit addition of 1 beaten egg in instructions (not in provided ingredients list).
Sesame present due to sesame seed oil; conservative classification for allergen.
Chicken stock treated as non-vegetarian/vegan per dietary notes and name; no fish/shellfish explicitly listed but null due to possible hidden ingredients in commercial stock.
Mushrooms, peas, and spring onions treated as standard produce with no allergens.
Cornstarch treated as corn-derived (gluten-free) but wheat-based versions exist, hence null for gluten-free and wheat.
No dairy, tree nuts, or peanuts listed or implied.
instructions:
In a wok add chicken broth and wait for it to boil.
Next add salt, sugar, white pepper, sesame seed oil.
When the chicken broth is boiling add the vegetables to the wok.
To thicken the sauce, whisk together 1 Tablespoon of cornstarch and 2 Tablespoon of water in a bowl and slowly add to your soup until it's the right thickness.
Next add 1 egg slightly beaten with a knife or fork and add it to the soup slowly and stir for 8 seconds
Serve the soup in a bowl and add the green onions on top.

ingredients.assumptions: 3 US cups commercial chicken broth/stock; ~240 g per cup; low-fat, lightly salted typical values.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: pinch of white pepper; ~0.3 g estimated, negligible macros.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp sesame oil; typical density ~0.92 g/ml.

ingredients.name: Peas
ingredients.assumptions: 1/3 cup frozen green peas; ~50 g typical; values for cooked peas.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: 1/3 cup sliced fresh mushrooms (e.g. button or shiitake); ~35 g; added raw then cooked in soup.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1/4 cup chopped spring/green onions; ~25 g; added raw as garnish.
